label: Club or society
tagline: For a choir, scout group, sports club or any other club.
name: The Club Game

spaces.35: The coach for the day out

chance.text: Everyone is here. Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
You help out at {24}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
Everyone is waiting for you at {11}. Hurry up. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
The lights go out. Go to {12} or {28}, whichever is closer. If someone owns it, pay 10 times your last throw.
You get a lift to the day out. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
You forgot the key and go back for it. Go to the nearest {station}. If someone owns it, pay double rent.
Your ticket wins in the raffle.
The oldest member puts in a good word. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You walk into the wrong room. Go back three spaces.
You lost the key to the building. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
The place where you meet gets a new roof. Pay {currency}30 per {house} and {currency}120 per {hotel}.
You forgot to pay your membership fee.
The car share leaves from {5}. Go there. If you pass {0} on the way, take {currency}200 from the bank.
It is your birthday and you treat the whole group. Pay each player {currency}40.
A former member sends you a gift for all your help.
You get to give a speech at {39}. Go there.

chest.text: A new club year starts. Go to {0}. Collect {currency}200 from the bank.
The yearly fundraiser brings in more than ever.
You drop the coffee pot and buy a new one.
You get the deposit for your key back.
Another member takes the blame. Keep this card. You can use it once to get out of {jail}.
You left all the lights on. Go to {jail} right away, without passing {0}.
You win volunteer of the year.
You find money in the lost property box.
You have been a member for 25 years. Each player gives you {currency}10.
Every ticket for the yearly raffle is sold.
The heating was on all winter.
You pay for the anniversary cake yourself.
The council gives a small grant.
The hall gets a fresh coat of paint. Pay {currency}35 per {house} and {currency}100 per {hotel}.
You get a thank-you card with a small voucher in it.
You sell old club things at the jumble sale.

houseRules: Whoever buys a street shares a good memory of the club.
Whoever throws a double pours drinks for the table.
Whoever has been a member longest may explain the rules once per game.
